title: CS69013: Programming And Data Structures Lab
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

(i) Familiarization of a computer and the environment and execution of sample
programs (ii) Expression evaluation (iii) Conditionals and branching, (iv)
Iteration (v) Functions (vi) Recursion (vii) Arrays (viii) Structures (ix)
Linked lists (x) Data structures.
It is suggested that some problems related to continuous domain problems in
engineering and their numerical solutions be given as laboratory assignments.
